subject: world_language
concept: Reflecting on one's own language-learning journey and articulating a plan for continued use and growth beyond formal study
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Agency Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student reviews a timeline of their own language journey from first words through capstone mastery
exercise.abstract: Student writes a reflective statement on their language-learning growth and a specific plan for continued use of the language

assessment.mastery_threshold: reflection is genuine and specific, and the continuation plan names a real, concrete way to keep using the language
misconception_flags: states a vague intention to 'keep practicing' without any specific, real plan for continued use

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
